result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there is one clear localization/content bug: a section heading renders as the raw key “home_feed.popular_title” instead of user-facing copy. Minor carousel truncation/clipping is visible but appears consistent with horizontal scrolling patterns.

issues.description: A section title displays the untranslated localization key “home_feed.popular_title” rather than readable text such as “Popular near you”.
issues.suggestion: Fix the i18n mapping or add a fallback so missing translation keys never render raw identifiers in production.

issues.description: The right edge of horizontally scrollable areas cuts off content, including category chips after “Healthy” and the “Trattoria Piccol...” card, without a strong visual affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade, peek spacing, or a scroll indicator so clipped content more clearly communicates horizontal scrolling.
